paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
notes: This is a theory/phenomenology paper proposing ultra-peripheral Pb-Pb collisions at the LHC as a new search strategy for ALPs. Figure 4 shows expected sensitivities (projections) for future searches at 1 nb^-1 and 10 nb^-1 integrated luminosity, not measured limits. The paper recasts some existing LEP and LHC diphoton/multiphoton search constraints on ALPs coupling to photons (aFFe operator) and hypercharge (aBBe operator), but these are not new measurements. No measured exclusion limit is reported.
